limitations: The endpoint exposes stochastic diffusion samples, not a fixed seed parameter.

U is a request-side sensitivity arm with independently shuffled per-chain homolog rows and blank pairing keys; processed features are unavailable remotely, so it is not the registered verified strict-U condition.
Full PAE matrices and exact deployed checkpoint hashes are not exposed by this hosted endpoint.
ART-versus-NART classification, empirical specificity calibration, phylogenetic independence, and confirmatory power gates remain unresolved.
NTD boundaries are operational first-RVT1-envelope boundaries; domain controls remain exploratory.
Alternative source pairings are not experimentally demonstrated nonbinders.
Diffusion samples, cells, and sequence clusters are not independent biological replicates.
